    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    r = next((i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if any(x in (2,8) for x in row)), None)

    marks = [j for j,x in enumerate(row) if x in (2,8)]

        right = j

        height = max(1, min(r, max(j-left, right-j)+1))
        for k in range(1, height+1):

    return out
